item.name: Auth

request.description:
## Endpoint Description

This endpoint is used to create a new staff member in the system. By sending a POST request to `{{base_url}}/v1/auth/staff`, you can register a staff member by providing their personal and professional details.

### Request Parameters

The request body must be sent in `form-data` format and should include the following parameters:

- **lastName** (text): The last name of the staff member.
    
- **firstName** (text): The first name of the staff member.
    
- **middleName** (text): The middle name of the staff member (optional).
    
- **position** (text): The position or job title of the staff member.
    

### Response Structure

Upon a successful request, the server will respond with a status code of `201 Created` and a JSON object containing the following fields:

- **id**: A unique identifier for the newly created staff member.
    
- **lastName**: The last name of the staff member.
    
- **firstName**: The first name of the staff member.
    
- **middleName**: The middle name of the staff member.
    
- **position**: The position or job title of the staff member.
    
- **department**: The department the staff member belongs to (may be null).
    
- **workPhone**: The work phone number of the staff member (may be null).
    
- **personalPhone**: The personal phone number of the staff member (may be null).
    
- **workEmail**: The work email address of the staff member (may be null).
    
- **hireDate**: The date the staff member was hired (may be null).
    
- **birthDate**: The birth date of the staff member (may be null).
    
- **telegramChatId**: The Telegram chat ID for the staff member (may be null).
    
- **maxChatId**: The maximum chat ID for the staff member (may be null).
    
- **notes**: Any additional notes regarding the staff member (may be null).
    
- **terminated**: A boolean indicating whether the staff member is terminated.
    

### Usage Notes

Ensure that all required fields are provided in the request. The response will confirm the creation of the staff member and provide their details. Utilize the `id` field for any further operations related to the staff member.
